records.title: Mix-QViT: Mixed-Precision Vision Transformer Quantization Driven by Layer Importance and Quantization Sensitivity
records.reason: Mix-QViT assigns mixed precision using layer importance and quantization sensitivity for vision transformers. It studies quantized ViT accuracy and deployment, but does not evaluate language-model inference.

records.title: FNM-Trans: Efficient FPGA-based Transformer Architecture with Full N:M Sparsity
records.reason: ACM publisher full text was inaccessible. Abstract describes an FPGA transformer architecture supporting full N:M sparsity, directly adjacent to the linked FTRANS accelerator family, but full design, evaluation, and limitations need primary-body review.

records.title: Promptus: Can Prompts Streaming Replace Video Streaming with Stable Diffusion
records.reason: Promptus proposes transmitting prompts to regenerate video with Stable Diffusion as an alternative to streaming video. The efficiency is in communication/video delivery, not transformer/LLM inference.

records.title: A Cost-Efficient FPGA-Based CNN-Transformer Using Neural ODE
records.reason: The paper combines CNN, Transformer, and Neural ODE components in an FPGA image-recognition accelerator. It reports cost/efficiency motivations but is vision hardware, not LLM inference.
